---
title: "Summary · Inside a Sandcastle"
---

## Key takeaways

- A **Sandcastle** is an isolated, disposable engineering workspace
  that runs an engineering agent under constrained tools and
  permissions, uses a branch on a target repository as its input
  and output surface, and preserves the resulting engineering work
  as durable Git artifacts.
- Sandcastle sits between Crossplane and Pico in the academy story:
  **Crossplane composes**, **Sandcastle constructs**, **Picos
  behave**.
- The Sandcastle construction layer is defined by five concerns:
  **isolated workspaces**, **repo/branch flow**, **tools and
  permissions**, **agent iteration**, and **artifact boundaries**.
  All Sandcastle-shaped tooling should address these five concerns
  regardless of the specific sandbox provider it uses.
- The Sandcastle is *safe to be disposable* because the workspace,
  tools, and agent scratch state are all disposable, while the only
  thing that crosses the artifact boundary is the committed Git
  branch.
- The Sandcastle owns the **inner iteration loop** (inspect →
  generate → validate → commit) but does **not** own the
  surrounding delivery loop (branch → PR → merge → GitOps →
  Crossplane reconciliation).
- This wave of the course delivers **substantive instruction**, a
  paper [Exercise](exercise.qmd) blueprint, and a runnable
  Sandcastle [Lab](lab.qmd) that links to the reusable
  [Hello World Pico Sandcastle lab](../../../../labs/hello-world-pico-sandcastle/)
  under `labs/`.

## What comes next

- **Part 2 — Composing Sandcastles with Crossplane** will develop
  how a Crossplane Composition can *request* engineering work from
  a Sandcastle and reconcile the returned artifacts. See
  [Part 2](../../part-2/index.qmd) for the scaffolded outline.
- **Part 3 — Delivering artifacts from a Sandcastle** will develop
  the outer delivery loop and the guardrails that live outside the
  Sandcastle's boundary. See [Part 3](../../part-3/index.qmd).
- The reusable Hello Pico artifact you would ultimately have a
  Sandcastle build is already documented at
  [`labs/hello-pico/`](../../../../labs/hello-pico/), and the
  downstream Kubernetes composition of the same artifact is at
  [`labs/hello-pico-on-kubernetes/`](../../../../labs/hello-pico-on-kubernetes/).
  Together they define the endpoints a future runnable Sandcastle
  lab will connect.
